question_text: Which of the following best describes your primary financial regulatory classification (Money Services Business, Lender, Digital Asset, or Depository)?
remediation_action: Determine classification to trigger appropriate regulatory compliance pathways.

question_text: Is the company registered as a Money Services Business (MSB) with FinCEN, and does it maintain active Money Transmitter Licenses (MTLs) in all applicable US states?
remediation_action: Suspend unlicensed operations; register with FinCEN and initiate state-by-state MTL applications immediately.

question_text: Are all loan products fully compliant with the Truth in Lending Act (TILA), Equal Credit Opportunity Act (ECOA), and state-level usury rate caps?
remediation_action: Engage regulatory counsel to audit loan origination flow, APR calculations, and adverse action notices.

question_text: Has the company obtained a BitLicense (if operating in NY) and completed an independent audit of its digital asset custody and cold-storage architecture?
remediation_action: Execute an independent proof-of-reserves (PoR) audit and secure necessary state virtual currency licenses.

question_text: Does the company have a documented Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC/KYB) compliance program integrated into user onboarding?
remediation_action: Integrate a certified third-party KYC/AML identity verification API and designate a formal BSA/AML Compliance Officer.

question_text: Is the company fully PCI-DSS v4.0 compliant for handling cardholder data, and has an independent Report on Compliance (ROC) been issued?
remediation_action: Initiate a PCI-DSS v4.0 readiness assessment and implement point-to-point encryption (P2PE).

question_text: Is the platform compliant with the CFPB Section 1033 Personal Financial Data Rights rule (phased compliance starting 2026), ensuring consumer data portability without screen-scraping?
remediation_action: Migrate away from screen-scraping reliance and integrate direct, secure APIs for financial data sharing.

question_text: Are consumer funds held in FBO (For Benefit Of) accounts at an FDIC-insured sponsor bank, with strictly documented daily reconciliation processes?
remediation_action: Establish FBO accounts with a sponsor bank and implement automated daily ledger reconciliation.

question_text: What is your primary software delivery and customer model (B2B Enterprise SaaS, B2C Platform, or AI Infrastructure)?
remediation_action: Determine software delivery model to trigger specific data privacy and liability diligence.

question_text: Has the company completed an independent SOC 2 Type II audit covering Security, Availability, and Confidentiality trust services criteria?
remediation_action: Engage an external auditing firm to conduct a SOC 2 readiness assessment and establish an observation window.

question_text: Is the platform fully compliant with the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) and CPRA, including documented procedures for consumer data deletion requests?
remediation_action: Publish a compliant privacy policy and automate Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) deletion workflows.

question_text: Do active enterprise Service Level Agreements (SLAs) contain unlimited financial liability caps or automatic termination clauses for uptime failures?
remediation_action: Renegotiate standard Master Services Agreements (MSAs) to cap financial liability at 12 months of contract value.

question_text: Are proprietary machine learning models trained on user data, and do customer Terms of Service (TOS) explicitly grant the right to use this data for training purposes?
remediation_action: Update TOS to explicitly require opt-in/opt-out consent for model training and data anonymization.

question_text: Does the software architecture rely on any viral copyleft open-source licenses (e.g., GPL, AGPL) that could legally force the disclosure of proprietary source code?
remediation_action: Run a Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tool to identify and replace all copyleft dependencies.

question_text: Are there defined Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity Plans (BCP) with documented Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPO)?
remediation_action: Draft and execute an annual tabletop exercise for a catastrophic server failure to validate RTO/RPO targets.

question_text: Does the company comply with the SEC Item 1.05 cybersecurity rules by maintaining an incident response plan requiring material breach notification within 4 days?
remediation_action: Formalize a cyber incident response playbook with a strict materiality assessment and 4-day escalation trigger.

question_text: What is your primary manufacturing operational model (Contract Manufacturer, Heavy Industrial Equipment, or Chemicals and Materials)?
remediation_action: Determine manufacturing model to route environmental and supply chain diligence.

question_text: Has the company been cited for any Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) violations, and is the Total Recordable Incident Rate (TRIR) actively tracked?
remediation_action: Conduct a mock OSHA safety audit and implement a digital TRIR reporting dashboard.

question_text: What percentage of raw materials or critical components are single-sourced from vendors located in a single geographic region?
remediation_action: Develop a dual-sourcing procurement strategy to mitigate geopolitical and geographic supply chain risks.

question_text: Does the supply chain mapping confirm full compliance with the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act (UFLPA) to ensure no components are sourced from restricted regions?
remediation_action: Execute deep-tier supply chain tracing and secure certificates of origin from all Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers.

question_text: Are all manufactured or imported chemical substances fully registered and compliant with the EPA Toxic Substances Control Act (TSCA), including early 2027 PFAS reporting?
remediation_action: Conduct an immediate inventory audit to identify PFAS components and prepare TSCA Section 8(a)(7) reporting data.

question_text: Is the facility ISO 9001 certified for Quality Management Systems, and are regular statistical process control (SPC) audits conducted?
remediation_action: Initiate ISO 9001 gap analysis and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs) for continuous quality control.

question_text: Are there active environmental liabilities, and does the facility hold all required EPA permits for hazardous waste disposal and wastewater discharge?
remediation_action: Commission a Phase I Environmental Site Assessment (ESA) and verify all active state/federal discharge permits.

question_text: What is your primary CleanTech sub-sector (Solar and Wind Generation, Battery and Energy Storage, or Grid Infrastructure)?
remediation_action: Determine CleanTech sub-sector to trigger federal subsidy and grid compliance pathways.

question_text: What percentage of the company's projected revenue or CapEx funding is dependent on Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) tax credits or DOE grants?
remediation_action: Perform a sensitivity analysis modeling the financial impact of a 50% reduction in federal grant or tax credit availability.

question_text: Has the company secured all necessary state/local zoning permits, environmental impact reports (EIR), and utility grid interconnection approvals (under FERC Order 2023)?
remediation_action: Audit the interconnection queue status and prioritize filing comprehensive site-control and environmental impact studies.

question_text: Are there executed Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) or off-take contracts guaranteeing revenue for deployed grid assets?
remediation_action: Secure long-term corporate or utility off-take agreements to stabilize projected cash flows and bankability.

question_text: Is the supply chain for critical battery minerals (e.g., lithium, cobalt) audited for compliance with the IRA's domestic sourcing or free-trade agreement requirements?
remediation_action: Restructure procurement contracts to source critical minerals from US or approved free-trade agreement nations to retain tax credit eligibility.

question_text: Does the company maintain a performance warranty reserve for hardware degradation or long-term operational and maintenance (O&M) liabilities?
remediation_action: Establish a dedicated cash reserve explicitly modeled against the projected degradation curve of deployed hardware.

question_text: Is the operational technology (OT) network strictly segmented from the IT network to comply with NERC CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) cybersecurity standards?
remediation_action: Execute an architecture overhaul to establish air-gapped or firewalled segmentation between IT systems and physical grid OT.
